name: MatBench
intro: MatBench 是标准化材料属性预测基准，汇集 10 个 DFT 或实验数据源并定义 13 项任务，其中 10 项回归、3 项分类；每项任务使用固定五折嵌套交叉验证。本站同时记录 Intern-S1/OpenCompass 的生成式 LLM 适配器：它只选择其中四项任务，并使用不同的裁判与综合分口径。
org: Citrine Informatics, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory
build_method: 多源材料属性数据清洗, 固定嵌套五折交叉验证
modality: 材料成分, 晶体结构, 数值属性
task_type: 材料属性预测, 回归, 分类
eval_feature: 固定嵌套交叉验证, 四任务LLM适配器
variant: MatBench v0.1; later Intern-S1/OpenCompass four-task adapter
modality_en: Material composition, crystal structure, numerical properties
build_method_en: Multi-source materials-property cleaning, fixed nested five-fold cross-validation
eval_feature_en: Fixed nested cross-validation, four-task LLM adapter
intro_en: MatBench is a standardized materials-property prediction benchmark built from ten DFT-derived or experimental sources and organized into 13 tasks: ten regression and three classification tasks. Every task uses fixed five-fold nested cross-validation. This page also documents the Intern-S1/OpenCompass generative LLM adapter, which selects only four tasks and uses a distinct judging and aggregate-score protocol.

drawio_review_note: Source-only audit completed 2026-07-21 against MatBench paper arXiv:2005.00707v2 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.00707v2), official materialsproject/matbench v0.6 snapshot 936176db18ca4cd7b38cbd957c017a5bac770c6b (https://github.com/materialsproject/matbench/tree/936176db18ca4cd7b38cbd957c017a5bac770c6b), Intern-S1 snapshot f5de1701fafaa0bbfef435f07b505796a226b5d9 (https://github.com/InternLM/Intern-S1/tree/f5de1701fafaa0bbfef435f07b505796a226b5d9), and OpenCompass snapshot 34da831f41494ebc3ece902fc9200dbba696a93e (https://github.com/open-compass/opencompass/tree/34da831f41494ebc3ece902fc9200dbba696a93e). The paper protocol creates 13 tasks from 10 DFT-derived or experimental datasets. Methods Table 2 enumerates task-specific modifications 1–11, including auxiliary-column removal in items 7/8; these are not 11 universal filters, and auxiliary-column removal must not be counted twice as a separate common step. The paper's Table 1 reports 1,296 phonons samples (v2 PDF p.7), whereas the pinned v0.6 metadata reports 1,265; the diagram preserves this package drift explicitly. MatBench fixes five uniformly randomized outer folds with seed 18012019, uses StratifiedKFold for the three classification tasks, gives 80% train/validation and 20% test to each outer run, permits model-dependent inner validation only inside the outer training portion, and averages MAE for ten regression tasks or ROC-AUC for three classification tasks over five held-out folds. The official package rejects missing, extra, or wrong-length held-out predictions and additionally stores diagnostic metrics; the diagram keeps the paper's headline MAE/ROC-AUC contract. The later OpenCompass adapter is not that protocol: at the pinned snapshot MatbenchDataset loads only matbench_base_fold_0_*_test.json for matbench_steels, matbench_expt_gap, matbench_expt_is_metal, and matbench_glass. Its numeric judge requests one float and maps incomplete/undetermined or numberless output to 0 before MAE. Its classification prompt inconsistently asks for A/B and later CORRECT/INCORRECT, while the parser searches only the first A or B; output without either becomes unknown and contributes no correct count while remaining in the denominator. The summarizer maps gap MAE by (2-MAE)/2*100, steels MAE by (2000-MAE)/2000*100, leaves the two 0-100 accuracies unchanged, then takes their unweighted arithmetic mean. MatBench code is MIT-licensed and tasks are publicly distributed; the original ten upstream sources retain their own provenance. Paper/source do not disclose a single universal inner-CV design because it is algorithm-dependent. Formal drawio/SVG/PNG assets are intentionally outside this source-only edit. Formal publication evidence [site-a11r-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 2445×641 (English) and 2445×641 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 2443×639 and 2443×639. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
